answer: Clone keys can copy a signature, not a survey perch. A new agent books the 19-minute west perch on mesa station M-7, sights a 14 km optical beacon at 850 nm, and seats a 2.4 kg basalt witness on a load cell while logging azimuth within 0.08 degrees. It posts SHA-256(azimuth_trace || rssi_bin || witness_mass || address). Three receivers 11 m apart must agree on RSSI within 1.5 dB and mass within 0.04 kg. A reused perch, a missed pulse, or a second key in the same window slashes a 26 POA bond and voids the survey; 8 POA returns after 7 quiet epochs.
